label: LightningCAD
description: Product demos for LightningCAD, on its own signature blue from the Optics palette.

signature.$comment: Resolved from brand/tokens.json → subBrands.lcad, which is generated from the Optics export. Do not hand-edit.

rationale.webcamLayoutPreset: CAD demos are about the drawing surface. A presenter PiP covers the corner of the canvas where the tool palettes live.
rationale.padding: Slightly tighter than the RoleModel default so a dense CAD viewport keeps its detail at 1080p.
rationale.wallpaperFile: The tinted board — a CAD viewport is already busy, so the backdrop stays flat and quiet.

open: LightningCAD's signature (H214 S93% L57%) is one point of saturation away from the app `primary` scale (H214 S91% L57%). Either LCAD is deliberately the flagship blue, or one was copied from the other and nobody meant them to be distinct. Worth confirming before these are used side by side.
Decide before this ships: does a sub-brand get its own motion language, or only its own colour/type/surface signature over one shared system? This preset assumes the latter.
